description: Run MeTube — a yt-dlp web UI — in Docker on the remote, bound to loopback 127.0.0.1:8081 (reached only over the SSH tunnel). Paste a video/playlist URL in the web UI and yt-dlp downloads it on the server into ~/yt-dlp-downloads, merged to mp4. Inspired by a Docker yt-dlp setup.

steps.description: Check this server can install Docker unattended: curl present, and root without a password prompt.
steps.run: if ! command -v curl >/dev/null 2>&1; then echo "curl is not installed on this server. Install it (apt install curl) and run setup again." >&2; fi; if ! { [ "$(id -u)" = 0 ] || sudo -n true; } >/dev/null 2>&1; then echo "This account cannot become root without a password prompt. Recipe steps run on an SSH channel with no terminal, so sudo has nowhere to ask for a password and would wait forever instead of prompting. Connect as root, or give this user passwordless sudo, then run setup again." >&2; fi; exit 1

steps.description: Install Docker if it isn't already (official get.docker.com script). Skipped if docker is present.
steps.run: SUDO=; [ "$(id -u)" = 0 ] || SUDO="sudo -n"; d=$(mktemp -d) || exit 1; echo "Fetching get.docker.com..."; curl -fsSL https://get.docker.com -o "$d/get-docker.sh" || exit 1; printf 'DPkg::Lock::Timeout "120";\n' > "$d/apt.conf"; echo "Installing Docker. The installer runs apt quietly, so expect a few minutes with no further output."; $SUDO env APT_CONFIG="$d/apt.conf" DEBIAN_FRONTEND=noninteractive NEEDRESTART_MODE=a NEEDRESTART_SUSPEND=1 sh "$d/get-docker.sh" </dev/null; rc=$?; rm -rf "$d"; [ $rc -eq 0 ] || exit $rc; $SUDO usermod -aG docker "$(id -un)" >/dev/null 2>&1 || true; echo "Docker installed."

steps.description: Start the MeTube container: web UI on 127.0.0.1:8081, downloads in ~/yt-dlp-downloads, merged to mp4.
steps.check: docker ps --filter name=metube --filter status=running -q 2>/dev/null | grep -q . || sudo -n docker ps --filter name=metube --filter status=running -q 2>/dev/null | grep -q .
steps.run: DK=docker; docker info >/dev/null 2>&1 || DK="sudo -n docker"; mkdir -p "$HOME/yt-dlp-downloads"; $DK rm -f metube >/dev/null 2>&1 || true; echo "Pulling the MeTube image..."; $DK pull ghcr.io/alexta69/metube || exit 1; echo "Starting the container..."; $DK run -d --name metube --restart unless-stopped -p 127.0.0.1:8081:8081 -v "$HOME/yt-dlp-downloads:/downloads" -e PUID=$(id -u) -e PGID=$(id -g) -e YTDL_OPTIONS='{"merge_output_format":"mp4"}' ghcr.io/alexta69/metube

steps.description: Wait for MeTube to finish starting.
steps.run: echo "Waiting for MeTube to answer on 127.0.0.1:8081..."; for i in $(seq 1 60); do curl -fsS http://127.0.0.1:8081/ >/dev/null 2>&1 && { echo "MeTube is up."; exit 0; }; sleep 2; done; echo "MeTube is still starting - give it a moment, then open it."

uninstall.description: Stop and remove the MeTube container. Your downloads in ~/yt-dlp-downloads are kept.
uninstall.run: DK=docker; docker info >/dev/null 2>&1 || DK="sudo -n docker"; $DK rm -f metube >/dev/null 2>&1 || true; echo "MeTube container removed; downloads in ~/yt-dlp-downloads are kept."
